in_sanskrit.name: अक्षयराज
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who rules over the immortal, the one who has an unending reign.

in_hindi.name: Akshayraj
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Immortal Ruler
in_hindi.long_meaning: Akshayraj एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Akshayraj is derived from two Sanskrit words, ‘Akshaya’ meaning immortal or inexhaustible and ‘Raj’ meaning ruler. The name Akshayraj signifies an immortal ruler, one who holds the power of eternal life and governs with wisdom and grace.
